content.text: You’ve written an ebook. You’ve priced it in USD. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are not options. How do you collect crypto payment and deliver the ebook automatically—without relying on platforms that can shut you down? This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. Here’s how it works: a buyer sends crypto to your wallet. A script verifies the payment on-chain. The ebook is delivered instantly. No platform holds your files. No subscription fees. No KYC. You own the stack. This is automated ebook delivery after crypto payment—built for creators in regions where conventional payment systems are restricted. It’s not a hack. It’s architecture.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a self-owned commerce system. When a buyer sends payment, a script verifies the transaction on-chain. If confirmed, the script sends the ebook directly to the buyer. No third-party platform handles the file or payment. You control the entire process. This matters because in regions like Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Crypto is your only reliable payment option. But crypto payments are volatile—prices fluctuate, networks differ, and buyers expect instant delivery. This system solves that. It converts the crypto price to USD at transaction time, verifies payment on-chain, and delivers the ebook automatically. No manual work. No platform dependence. You own the infrastructure. It’s not a workaround. It’s a sovereign commerce stack.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is simple but robust. First, the buyer sends crypto to your wallet. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain—checking for the correct amount and network. Once confirmed, a webhook triggers a script (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker). The script pulls the ebook from your storage (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2) and sends it to the buyer’s email or download link. The entire process takes seconds. No data is stored on platforms you don’t control. The script runs on serverless infrastructure, so there’s no server to manage. The payment verification is automatic, and the delivery is instant. This is base-layer infrastructure—no platform, no subscriptions, no KYC. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely. The buyer gets the ebook. You get paid. No middlemen.

You need infrastructure you own. This system gives you that. It’s not a temporary solution. It’s a permanent architecture. You deploy it once, and it works indefinitely. No platform fees. No payment rejections. No data ownership issues. It’s built for creators who want to sell globally without depending on systems that exclude them. It’s sovereign commerce infrastructure—designed to work where conventional systems fail.
Crypto payment verification is automatic—no manual work required.

These components work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your product page. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic—verifying payments and delivering files. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your ebook. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is self-hosted or serverless. Together, they form a sovereign commerce stack. You own every piece. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Just infrastructure you control.
